items.title: U.S. bombs Iranian nuclear sites
items.raw_content: The US hit three nuclear sites in Iran overnight - but it remains unclear whether the strikes did destroy all of Iran's nuclear capabilities.
items.title_zh: 美国轰炸伊朗核设施
items.summary: The US struck three nuclear sites in Iran overnight, BBC coverage says, though it remains unclear whether the strikes destroyed all of Iran's nuclear capabilities.

items.title: WeChat’s HarmonyOS version surpasses six million installs
items.raw_content: According to data from Huawei’s AppGallery, the HarmonyOS version of WeChat has surpassed 6 million installations, with an average of about 100,000
items.title_zh: 微信鸿蒙版安装量突破 600 万
items.summary: Data from Huawei's AppGallery shows that the HarmonyOS version of WeChat has surpassed 6 million installations.

items.title: MiniMax-M1 open-weight, large-scale hybrid-attention reasoning model
items.raw_content: MiniMax-M1, the world's first open-weight, large-scale hybrid-attention reasoning model. - MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-M1
items.title_zh: MiniMax-M1：开放权重的规模化混合注意力推理模型
items.summary: MiniMax-M1 is described as the first open-weight, large-scale reasoning model built on hybrid attention, published in the MiniMax-AI GitHub repository.

items.title: Microsoft suspended the email account of an ICC prosecutor at The Hague
items.title_zh: 微软暂停海牙国际刑事法院一名检察官的邮箱账户
items.summary: Microsoft suspended the email account of an International Criminal Court prosecutor based in The Hague, according to The New York Times.

items.title: Meta announces Oakley smart glasses
items.title_zh: Meta 发布 Oakley 智能眼镜
items.summary: Meta announced Oakley-branded AI smart glasses, according to the company's official announcement. The Verge reports on the product.

items.title: U.S. bombs Iranian nuclear sites
items.title_zh: 美国轰炸伊朗核设施
items.summary: The US struck three nuclear sites in Iran overnight, BBC coverage says, though it remains unclear whether the strikes destroyed all of Iran's nuclear capabilities.

items.title: MiniMax-M1 open-weight, large-scale hybrid-attention reasoning model
items.title_zh: MiniMax-M1：开放权重的规模化混合注意力推理模型
items.summary: MiniMax-M1 is described as the first open-weight, large-scale reasoning model built on hybrid attention, published in the MiniMax-AI GitHub repository.

items.title: Microsoft suspended the email account of an ICC prosecutor at The Hague
items.title_zh: 微软暂停海牙国际刑事法院一名检察官的邮箱账户
items.summary: Microsoft suspended the email account of an International Criminal Court prosecutor based in The Hague, according to The New York Times.

items.title: Meta announces Oakley smart glasses
items.title_zh: Meta 发布 Oakley 智能眼镜
items.summary: Meta announced Oakley-branded AI smart glasses, according to the company's official announcement. The Verge reports on the product.

items.title: A brief, incomplete, and mostly wrong history of robotics
items.title_zh: 一份简短、不完整且多半错误的机器人学史
items.summary: A humorous essay offers a brief, deliberately incomplete history of robotics, written as an homage to a similar piece about programming languages.

items.title: Salesforce study finds LLM agents flunk CRM and confidentiality tests
items.title_zh: Salesforce 研究：LLM 智能体未通过 CRM 与保密性测试
items.summary: A benchmark led by Salesforce AI researcher Kung-Hsiang Huang found that LLM agents achieved about a 58% success rate on single-step CRM tasks and failed to recognize the need for customer confidentiality, according to The Register.

items.title: Honda conducts successful launch and landing of experimental reusable rocket
items.title_zh: 本田成功完成实验性可重复使用火箭的发射与着陆
items.summary: Honda R&D says it successfully launched and landed an experimental reusable rocket measuring 6.3 m long, the first time Honda has landed a rocket after reaching an altitude of nearly 300 meters.

items.title: Timescale Is Now TigerData
items.title_zh: Timescale 更名为 TigerData
items.summary: Timescale, the company behind TimescaleDB, has renamed itself TigerData; cofounders Ajay Kulkarni and Mike Freedman discuss how the new name reflects the company.

items.title: Scrappy – Make little apps for you and your friends
items.title_zh: Scrappy——为自己和朋友做小应用
items.summary: Scrappy is a project for making small apps for yourself and your friends, framed around the gap between mass-market app-store software and costly enterprise applications.

items.title: Base44 sells to Wix for $80M cash
items.title_zh: Base44 以 8000 万美元现金出售给 Wix
items.summary: In its six months as a standalone company, Base44 reportedly grew to 250,000 users and was earning nearly $200,000 in monthly profits before selling to Wix for $80 million in cash.

items.title: Show HN: EnrichMCP – A Python ORM for Agents
items.title_zh: Show HN：EnrichMCP——面向 Agent 的 Python ORM
items.summary: EnrichMCP is an open-source Python ORM framework built on MCP that turns data models into a type-safe, introspectable interface agents can discover and invoke, with automatic tool generation and Pydantic validation.

items.title: Infinite Mac OS X
items.title_zh: Infinite Mac 现已能运行早期 Mac OS X
items.summary: The Infinite Mac emulation project can now run early versions of Mac OS X, with 10.1 and 10.3 the best supported. The author says performance is not particularly snappy and notes that Infinite HD was rebuilt to include notable indie software from that era.

items.title: Agentic Misalignment: How LLMs could be insider threats
items.title_zh: Agentic Misalignment：LLM 如何成为内部威胁
items.summary: New research explores simulated blackmail, industrial espionage and other misaligned behaviors in LLMs, examining whether models could act as insider threats.

items.title: Sega mistakenly reveals sales numbers of popular games
items.title_zh: 世嘉意外泄露多款热门游戏的销量数据
items.summary: Sega mistakenly revealed sales figures for several popular games, according to a report on the apparent leak.

items.title: How fast are Linux pipes anyway? (2022)
items.title_zh: Linux 管道到底有多快？（2022）
items.summary: The post iteratively optimizes a simple Linux pipe-writing benchmark from 3.5GiB/s to 65GiB/s, using the perf tool to guide each improvement.

items.title: Writing a basic Linux device driver when you know nothing about Linux drivers
items.title_zh: 在完全不懂 Linux 驱动的情况下写一个基础的 Linux 设备驱动
items.summary: After buying a USB hub that only supported Windows and macOS, the author reverse-engineered its protocol and wrote a Linux driver; the vendor's support team reportedly sent full protocol documentation within four hours.

items.title: Accumulation of cognitive debt when using an AI assistant for essay writing task
items.title_zh: 使用 AI 助手撰写文章时认知债务的累积
items.summary: In a study of 54 participants, essay writers using an LLM, a search engine, or no tools showed within-group homogeneity in named entities, n-gram patterns, and topic ontology, while EEG revealed significantly different brain connectivity, with brain-only participants showing the strongest, most distributed networks.

items.title: Is there a half-life for the success rates of AI agents?
items.title_zh: AI 智能体的成功率存在半衰期吗？
items.summary: Building on Kwa et al. (2025), Toby Ord shows that AI agents' performance on longer research-engineering tasks can be explained by a simple model with a constant failure rate per minute of human-equivalent work.

items.title: WeChat’s HarmonyOS version surpasses six million installs
items.title_zh: 微信鸿蒙版安装量突破 600 万
items.summary: Data from Huawei's AppGallery shows that the HarmonyOS version of WeChat has surpassed 6 million installations.

items.title: CATL to build 10 battery swap stations in Hong Kong by 2027
items.title_zh: 宁德时代计划到 2027 年在香港建设 10 座换电站
items.summary: CATL plans to build 10 battery swap stations for electric vehicles across Hong Kong, according to a TechNode report.

items.title: Japan’s Nissan receives more than 20,000 non-refundable orders for China-specific N7 sedan
items.title_zh: 日产在华专属 N7 轿车收到逾 2 万份不可退订单
items.summary: Dongfeng-Nissan, the joint venture between Nissan and Dongfeng Motor, says it has received more than 20,000 non-refundable orders for the China-specific N7 sedan, TechNode reports.

items.title: Rising 2nm chip costs may drive Samsung to use Chinese suppliers for Galaxy S26 OLED panels
items.title_zh: 2nm 芯片成本上升，或促使三星为 Galaxy S26 OLED 面板采用中国供应商
items.summary: Rising 2nm chip costs may push Samsung to source certain OLED panel materials from Chinese firms, shifting away from its traditional suppliers in South Korea and the US, TechNode reports.

items.title: Huawei chairman Xu Zhijun calls for new growth drivers in the telecom industry｜MWC Shanghai 2025
items.title_zh: 华为董事长徐直军呼吁电信行业寻找新增长引擎｜MWC 上海 2025
items.summary: At a keynote at MWC Shanghai 2025, Huawei rotating chairman Xu Zhijun addressed the growth challenges facing the global telecom industry.

items.title: BEYOND Expo 2025: Key facts about China’s flying car players and their expansion plans
items.title_zh: BEYOND Expo 2025：中国飞行汽车玩家与扩张计划的关键事实
items.summary: TechNode rounds up key facts about China's flying-car companies and their expansion plans from BEYOND Expo 2025. Yang Jun, a fellow of the Canadian Academy of Engineering, said the low-altitude economy is one of the few business models created by China and offers a chance to lead.

items.title: Li Auto has more supercharging locations than Tesla in China, CEO says
items.title_zh: 理想汽车 CEO 称其在华超充站数量已超过特斯拉
items.summary: Li Auto has opened its 2,500th supercharging station, located at the Shanghai Disneyland resort. According to its CEO, the Chinese EV maker now has more supercharging locations in China than Tesla.

items.title: Global robotic vacuum shipments reach 5.1 million in Q1, top four Chinese brands hold 54.1% market share
items.title_zh: 一季度全球扫地机器人出货量达 510 万台，中国四大品牌占 54.1% 份额
items.summary: IDC data shows global smart robotic vacuum shipments reached about 5.1 million units in the first quarter, with the top four Chinese brands holding a combined 54.1% market share.

items.title: NetEase’s 24 Entertainment reveals trailer for action-adventure game Blood Message
items.title_zh: 网易 24 Entertainment 公布动作冒险游戏《Blood Message》预告片
items.summary: NetEase's gaming studio 24 Entertainment unveiled a trailer on Friday for Blood Message, an upcoming single-player action-adventure game.

items.title: 0voice/EmbeddedSoftwareLearn
items.title_zh: 0voice/EmbeddedSoftwareLearn：嵌入式软件开发学习路线
items.summary: A Chinese-language roadmap for learning embedded software development, spanning C/C++, drivers, networking, RTOS, embedded Linux, IoT, and toolchains.

items.title: vitali87/code-graph-rag
items.title_zh: vitali87/code-graph-rag：面向 monorepo 的代码知识图谱 RAG
items.summary: Code-graph-rag is a Python tool that combines AI and knowledge graphs to query, understand, and edit multi-language codebases in a monorepo.

items.title: tommybee456/OpenSplitDeck
items.title_zh: tommybee456/OpenSplitDeck：用现成零件与 3D 打印件打造的开源掌机手柄
items.summary: OpenSplitDeck is a Steam Deck-like controller built from a mix of off-the-shelf and 3D-printed parts, with custom hardware and firmware, written in C.

items.title: teamspeak/teamspeak6-server
items.title_zh: teamspeak/teamspeak6-server：TeamSpeak 6 服务器测试版
items.summary: The repository contains the beta of TeamSpeak 6 Server, giving testers early access to fixes and improvements ahead of the stable release.

items.title: winfunc/opcode
items.title_zh: winfunc/opcode：Claude Code 的 GUI 应用与工具包
items.summary: A GUI application and toolkit for Claude Code that lets users create custom agents, manage interactive sessions, and run secure background agents.

items.title: superdesigndev/superdesign
items.title_zh: superdesign：开源的 AI 产品设计智能体
items.summary: Superdesign is an open-source AI agent for product design, written in TypeScript. The GitHub project is developed by superdesigndev.

items.title: zebbern/claude-code-guide
items.title_zh: zebbern/claude-code-guide：Claude Code 使用指南
items.summary: A Python-based guide to Claude Code that collects setup instructions, commands, workflows, agents, skills and tips for users from beginner to power user.

items.title: nonbili/NouTube
items.title_zh: nonbili/NouTube：YouTube 与 YouTube Music 二合一客户端
items.summary: A TypeScript app that combines YouTube and YouTube Music in a single client, with no ads and background playback.

items.title: QuipNetwork/cpp-sdk
items.title_zh: QuipNetwork/cpp-sdk：Quip Network 的 C++ SDK
items.summary: QuipNetwork/cpp-sdk is a C++ software development kit published on GitHub by QuipNetwork. The repository listing offers little detail beyond the project name and its language.

items.title: fuergaosi233/claude-code-proxy
items.title_zh: fuergaosi233/claude-code-proxy：Claude Code 到 OpenAI API 的代理
items.summary: A Python proxy that routes Claude Code to the OpenAI API, according to the repository's brief description.

items.title: Early Attentive Sparsification Accelerates Neural Speech Transcription
items.title_zh: 早期注意力稀疏化加速神经语音转录
items.summary: NVIDIA researchers sparsify Whisper encoder hidden states early in the network and find that 40-60% sparsity with under 1% accuracy loss yields up to 1.6x faster English speech transcription on Nvidia GPUs without fine-tuning.

items.title: The Role of Explanation Styles and Perceived Accuracy on Decision Making in Predictive Process Monitoring
items.title_zh: 解释风格与感知准确度在预测性流程监控决策中的作用
items.summary: A user study investigates how feature-importance, rule-based, and counterfactual explanations, together with perceived AI accuracy, affect decision-making in predictive process monitoring, and finds both factors significant.

items.title: Reasoning about Uncertainty: Do Reasoning Models Know When They Don't Know?
items.title_zh: 关于不确定性的推理：推理模型知道自己不知道吗？
items.summary: The paper studies uncertainty quantification in reasoning models and finds they are usually overconfident, often stating more than 85% confidence on incorrect answers, with deeper reasoning making this worse; introspective prompting improved calibration for models such as o3-Mini and DeepSeek R1 but not for Claude 3.7 Sonnet.

items.title: Ace-CEFR -- A Dataset for Automated Evaluation of the Linguistic Difficulty of Conversational Texts for LLM Applications
items.title_zh: Ace-CEFR：面向 LLM 应用的对话文本语言难度自动评估数据集
items.summary: The authors release Ace-CEFR, a dataset of English conversational passages annotated by experts for difficulty level, and report that models trained on it judge text difficulty more accurately than human experts with production-suitable latency.

items.title: CopulaSMOTE: A Copula-Based Oversampling Approach for Imbalanced Classification in Diabetes Prediction
items.title_zh: CopulaSMOTE：面向糖尿病预测不平衡分类的 Copula 过采样方法
items.summary: CopulaSMOTE models the minority class's dependence structure with truncated vine copulas to generate synthetic samples; across three diabetes datasets it improved minority-class recovery mainly on the larger CDC BRFSS dataset, with benefits depending on classifier and metric.

items.title: Modeling Public Perceptions of Science in Media
items.title_zh: 媒体中公众科学认知的建模
items.summary: The paper introduces a framework modeling public perception of science across twelve dimensions, built on 10,489 annotations from 2,101 US and UK participants, and shows perception scores predict engagement on Reddit.

items.title: Out of Control -- Why Alignment Needs Formal Control Theory (and an Alignment Control Stack)
items.title_zh: 失控——为何对齐需要形式化控制理论（以及一套对齐控制栈）
items.summary: This position paper argues that formal optimal control theory should be central to AI alignment and introduces an Alignment Control Stack that organizes controls across physical to socio-technical layers to improve interoperability and regulatory assurance.

items.title: TalentMine: LLM-Based Extraction and Question-Answering from Multimodal Talent Tables
items.title_zh: TalentMine：基于 LLM 的多模态人才表格抽取与问答
items.summary: TalentMine is an LLM-based framework that turns extracted talent-management tables into semantically enriched representations for retrieval-augmented question answering, reporting 100% accuracy on employee benefits queries versus 0% for standard AWS Textract extraction.
